name: WorkOS
description:
The official WorkOS connector lets you manage your WorkOS workspace from Claude in plain language, backed by the same API that powers the WorkOS Dashboard .

Ask Claude to look up an organization, audit a user's memberships, check an SSO connection, inspect a Directory Sync (SCIM) setup, review roles and permissions, or make changes across 300+ operations spanning the WorkOS platform.

**What you can do**
- Query your data: organizations, users and memberships, SSO connections, Directory Sync directories and users, roles/permissions/groups (RBAC), audit logs and events, AuthKit applications, domains, webhooks, and more.
- Take action: create and update organizations, manage users and memberships, configure connections, and run other administrative operations.
- Discover what's available: Claude can list the supported operations and their inputs, then pick the right one for your request.

**Built for enterprise trust**
- Secure OAuth 2.0 authentication — Claude acts with your own WorkOS identity and permissions, never a shared API key, and only within a single environment.
- Destructive and billing-sensitive actions require explicit confirmation before they run.
- Admins can disable the connector or restrict it to read-only, and access is always scoped to what your role is allowed to do.

WorkOS is the enterprise-identity platform trusted by leading AI and SaaS companies for SSO, Directory Sync, AuthKit user management, RBAC, FGA, Vault, and audit logging. This connector brings that control surface into Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WorkOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WorkOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.workos.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WorkOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WorkOS provides these MCP tools: list_operations, mutate, query, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WorkOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to WorkOS in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
WorkOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WorkOS is developed by WorkOS. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
